name: CoreWeave
tagline: CoreWeave is a specialized GPU cloud provider focused exclusively on AI, machine learning, and visual compute workloads. It offers NVIDIA H100, A100, and L40S GPUs with bare-metal performance and Kubernetes orchestration. AI companies, model providers, and research labs use CoreWeave for large-scale training and inference that requires predictable GPU capacity.
